conditions_echo: Grade 5 Mathematics, end of Unit 4, proctored_in_class, individual, AI prohibited_and_enforced, paper and pencil only, summative, 25 minutes declared; the item type has been practised but these particular numbers are new to the students.
reviewer_notes: All three claims are already fully carried by this assessment's solution-and-explanation boxes and, for G5C3, item 9. The additional apparatus layered on top -- a prediction box on every item, full-sentence step-by-step explanations even for straightforward procedural computation, a one-page reflection essay, and a five-minute oral conference re-covering items 6 and 9 -- does not close any gap Gate 1 identifies for any of the three claims; it adds student writing time and per-student grading/conference time well beyond what the declared 25 minutes would comfortably hold, without adding independent evidentiary reach for G5C1, G5C2, or G5C3. If a claim-by-claim gap existed, this would be the assessment to trim, not to extend further.
